title: Kylian Mbappé 2024-25
body: Kylian Mbappé is a left-sided forward who finishes with either foot and attacks space behind a high line. In 2024-25 his contribution shows up in shots, touches in the box, and chances created from the left channel. He is less involved when a team asks him to defend for long spells in his own half.

title: Rodri 2024-25
body: Rodri is a single pivot who receives between the lines, switches play, and slows opponents in front of the back four. In 2024-25 his value is progressive passing, duel success in the middle third, and the way possession stays stable when he is the free player. He is not the runner who attacks the box in volume.

title: How to read a pressing forward
body: A pressing forward fits when defensive actions start high, pressures lead to turnovers in the final third, and the player still produces shots. Strong tackling numbers deep in his own half do not by themselves make him a pressing forward. Compare pressures in the attacking third, recoveries near the opponent box, and shot volume before recommending the role.
